Scene 03

Scene 03

[ tapping continues ]

[ screaming ]

Dana Scully

What a way to go. Have you seen this m.o. Before, detective? Men cremated alive?

Lieutenant Neary

Yeah. Third time this year.

Fox Mulder

Eleventh time, actually. There were three in Seattle, three in los angeles and two in boston. All chinese men between the ages of 20 and 40. All recent immigrants.

Lieutenant Neary

We weren't able to determine any of that until just recently. The other two bodies were much more badly burned. We got lucky with this one.

Fox Mulder

Lucky? That's an interesting word for it.

[ tapping glass eye ]

Fox Mulder

Got any leads on this case, detective? Any thoughts or ideas?

Lieutenant Neary

We've got a big influx of immigrants from hong kong, trying to get out before 1997. And we've seen stepped up gang activity in the chinese community, but so far we can't tie these deaths to anyone or anything.

Fox Mulder

You got anybody that can read or speak chinese?

Lieutenant Neary

Yeah. Glen Chao. He's right over there. Why?

Fox Mulder

Get him. I want to see if he can read this.

Lieutenant Neary

Sure. Glen.

Detective Glen Chao

One second.

Lieutenant Neary

Detective Chao. Glen Chao, agent Mulder.

Detective Glen Chao

Hi. What've you got? Hi.

Fox Mulder

There's something written up here. I was wondering if you could read it.

Detective Glen Chao

Yeah. It says, "gwai." it means "ghost."

Fox Mulder

Ghost?

Lieutenant Neary

Does that mean anything to you?

Fox Mulder

I don't know, but it's something strange for a man... Being burned alive to write, don't you think?

Lieutenant Neary

Yeah.

Fox Mulder

What's this? Anybody recognize this? Looks like some kind of foreign currency.

Detective Glen Chao

It's called "hell money." it's used as an offering during the chinese festival of the hungry ghosts.

Fox Mulder

Is it worth anything?

Detective Glen Chao

It's not money, per se. It's a symbolic offering to the evil spirits and the ghosts. For good luck.

Fox Mulder

Where would I get this "hell money?"

Detective Glen Chao

Well, there aren't a whole lot of places in chinatown that sell it.

Fox Mulder

That's good. Maybe we just found a way to identify the body.

Scene 04

Dana Scully

His name is johnny lo. He moved here about six months ago from canton. He's still in the I.n.s. Application process. He was a dishwasher in chinatown.

Fox Mulder

How many dishes do you have to break before your boss tosses you in an oven?

Dana Scully

I think it's pretty clear this is some kind of... A horrific cult or gang retribution killing.

Fox Mulder

Why would he write the character for ghost... On the inside of the crematory oven?

Dana Scully

I don't know.

Fox Mulder

What about the guard seeing three figures that seemed to vanish without a trace?

Dana Scully

So now we're chasing ghosts?

Fox Mulder

Who you gonna call? Ghosts or ancestral spirits have been central... To chinese spiritual life for centuries.

Dana Scully

So you're saying the ancestral spirits... Pushed johnny lo into the oven and turned on the gas?

Fox Mulder

Fox Mulder

Dana Scully

What this?

Detective Glen Chao

Chinese herbal medicine.

Dana Scully

What about this?

Detective Glen Chao

It's a dried frog. I think they're sometimes used as charms. Good health, prosperity, protection.

Fox Mulder

Looks like mr. Lo could've used a little of both. Let's get this blood tested.

Dana Scully

Detective Glen Chao

Fox Mulder

Haunted? You mean by ghosts?

Detective Glen Chao

Yeah. It's hard to give it an exact translation, but it's what I was telling you about before. The chinese yu lan hui-- the festival of the hungry ghosts. You see, on the 15th day of the seventh moon... In the chinese calendar, it's believed the Gates of hell are opened... And the ghosts of unwanted souls roam the earth. Now, believers protect themselves by leaving gifts of food... And "hell money" outside their homes to appease the ghosts, to keep them from coming inside and causing trouble. But for some spirits, the ghosts most feared by the chinese, there's no buying them off.

[ heart beating ]

Detective Glen Chao

The preta, the ancient ghost of a murdered man... Who wanders the earth exacting his revenge on the living, or the wu chang keui, who collects the souls of doomed men and drags them down to... Ti yu-- to the chinese hell.

Fox Mulder

Think these murders could be related?

Detective Glen Chao

Well, it makes sense. This year's festival is just about over.

Dana Scully

What about you, detective? Do you believe in yu lan hui?

Detective Glen Chao

I find it hard to argue with 2,000 years of chinese belief, the stuff my parents and grandparents believe in. But the truth is, I'm more haunted by the size of my mortgage payments.

Scene 09

Scene 09

Fox Mulder

What did you find?

Dana Scully

A lot. And I haven't even finished my preliminary visual exam. Look at this. This guy's like a jigsaw puzzle. These are all surgical incisions. And judging by the color of the scars, I'd say... They were all made within the last year.

Fox Mulder

What was wrong with him?

Dana Scully

If you ask me, nothing.

Fox Mulder

"nothing"? What do you mean?

Dana Scully

Do you know how much the human body is worth, Mulder?

Fox Mulder

Depends on the body. I don't know, a few bucks. How much?

Dana Scully

It's worth a fortune.

Fox Mulder

You're saying this guy was selling his body parts for money?

Dana Scully

A kidney, a portion of the liver, a cornea, bone marrow-- a person can lose these things and live to cash his social security checks.

Fox Mulder

He won't be cashing any social security checks any time soon.

Dana Scully

No, but if I'm right, this is one man who left his heart in san francisco.

Fox Mulder

Scully, even if you're right, it doesn't figure. There's no long-term business sense to dying. And what connection does this have to the crematory deaths?

Dana Scully

We only saw one body, but the only thing that wasn't burned to a delicate crisp... On johnny lo was his glass eye.

[ gasps ]

Scene 19

Scene 19

Hard-Faced Man

My people live with ghosts-- the ghosts of our fathers... And our fathers' fathers. They call to us from distant memory, showing us the path.

Dana Scully

No ghosts called to those men. You did, by preying on their hopelessness and their desperation.

Hard-Faced Man

Yes. They were desperate. Just as I was desperate when I first came to this country. But I... Committed no crime.

Dana Scully

You cheated them out of life... By promising them prosperity when the only possible reward was death.

Hard-Faced Man

In my belief, death is nothing to be feared. It's merely a stage of transition. But life without hope, hmph, now that's living hell. So-- hope was my gift to these men.

[ disgusted sigh ]

Hard-Faced Man

I don't expect you to understand.

Dana Scully

I understand this. You are going to prison for a very long time.

Fox Mulder

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

I checked with the donor procurement organization. She's been put on the recipient list.

Dana Scully

That's great.

Fox Mulder

Yeah.

Dana Scully

What's wrong?

Lieutenant Neary

It's our case against this guy. We've had our task force interviewing everybody we busted at the gaming parlor that night.

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

Dana Scully

Lieutenant Neary

We can't find him.

Fox Mulder

He was to testify before a grand jury this morning. When he didn't show, they went to his home. He's vanished... Like a ghost.
